headline: Why is being alone hardest now that the house is empty?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. The cards were hidden, yet your hand found the one standing alone beside a full table.
He stands by himself behind a table where every tool is present.
You asked why being alone is hardest now that the house is empty. The full table beside one figure catches me.
The house is empty, and being alone is harder now.
There's something between what is available and company. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's standing there…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You chose without seeing him and found the calmest figure in the deck.
He hangs upside down by one ankle. His face is calm.
You asked why the empty house has made solitude harder. This card makes me look at the calm inside the stillness.
Still, the empty house has changed the weight of the solitude you already knew.
What has hold of the solitude makes the empty space carry more weight. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what's holding this…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing revealed the picture, but your hand went to the one crossing a wide open space.
The full sky opens behind him, and he carries one small bundle.
You asked why being alone weighs more in that empty space. The wide sky and small bundle hold my attention.
But the open space feels heavier now, not freer.
Something turns up just where open space should feel like room to move. I don't think it started with you.
Now let's look at what's behind it…
